headline: Executive order changes an earlier order that placed tariffs on goods from Canada, which were tied to concerns about illegal drugs.
what_it_does: This order amends an earlier executive order that put extra import taxes, called duties or tariffs, on goods coming from Canada. The earlier order linked those duties to the flow of illegal drugs across the U.S.-Canada border. The title does not say exactly what was changed, so the specific details of the amendment are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. businesses that import goods from Canada
who_it_affects.how: The rules for duties they pay on Canadian goods may change under this amendment.

who_it_affects.group: Canadian companies that sell goods to the United States
who_it_affects.how: The tariff rules that apply to their products entering the U.S. may be adjusted.
